config.integrations.comment: Merging or cross mod usage of features
config.oarsplash.comment: Add Effective's Splash & Ripple Particles to Wakes boat particles
config.effbubblebreath.comment: Use Effective's bubbles for Effectual's breath bubble effect
config.effbubblechest.comment: Use Effective bubbles for Effectual's chest bubble effect
config.effbubblepots.comment: Use Effective bubbles for Effectual's pot bubble effect
config.breathsteam.comment: Replace Effectual's mouth steam with a modified cascade particle from Effective. Requires the explicit enable-ing of Mouth Steam in Effectual's Settings (as of version 1.4.1).
config.replaceripple.comment: Use Particle Rain's ripple in place of Effective's when (normal) droplets hit water
config.tweaks.comment: Features that require one target mod only
config.glowwakes.comment: Mimic a glowing appearance for wakes at night in Warm Oceans. Inspired by Effective's glowing water particles
config.glowclouds.comment: Mimic a glowing appearance for Wakes splash clouds at night in Warm Oceans. Inspired by Effective's glowing water particles
config.glowdrip.comment: Mimic a glowing appearance for Effectual's player drip effect at night in Warm Oceans. Inspired by Effective's glowing water particles
